title: A Black Hole Fired Jets 140 Milky Ways Long

scenes.text: One black hole shot out jets 140 Milky Ways long.
Astronomers call the system Porphyrion, and its jets stretch 23 million light years.
That's the biggest black hole jets ever found.
Line up 140 galaxies like ours end to end and you still wouldn't reach the tip.
And we're seeing it as it was when the universe was less than half its current age.

description:
Astronomers found the largest black hole jets ever recorded: 23 million light years from end to end.
That is about 140 Milky Way galaxies lined up. The findings were published in Nature.
How big can a single black hole's reach really get?
first_comment: Bonus: the jets date from when the universe was only 6.3 billion years old. What would you name a black hole this big?
